temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he was hiding something and says he is in some trouble, and he didn't know how to tell Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from him; Christian feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his suspicion is confirmed: Jonathan was hiding that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in some kind of trouble and had been hiding it from Christian.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious, worried, and concerned; possibly somewhat validated in his suspicion.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To get more details about Jonathan's trouble and decide how to respond.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he doesn't want to drag Christian into it, but he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and has been concealing it from Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Christian learns Jonathan is willing to accept help and that the trouble is complicated enough that Jonathan fears involving him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious, complicated trouble and needs Christian's support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worried, empathetic, and concerned for Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support Jonathan and help him get out of the mess.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian comes to suspect the trouble may involve criminal activity; in response to his question, Jonathan says he can't say for sure, might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but didn't do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in serious, complicated trouble and needs Christian's support; Christian does not yet know whether it is criminal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his suspicion of possible criminal involvement is partially confirmed and refined: Jonathan may have been involved with wrong people but denies illegal actions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be entangled with the wrong people and the situation may involve criminal activity, though Jonathan denies doing anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan and find out what is really going on.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people and the situation may involve criminal activity, though Jonathan denies doing anything illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his investigation changes his belief from possible entanglement or guilt to Jonathan being framed and innocent.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up, and Christian needs to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence to clear Jonathan's name and prove his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian discovers or realizes the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan; he tells Jonathan this and says he will confront them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed, and Christian is gathering evidence to identify the real culprit.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—he identifies the real culprit as someone close to both him and Jonathan, a trusted person.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The real culprit behind Jonathan's framing is someone close to both of them and trusted by both; this is a betrayal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice; ensure the betrayal is punished.
